AI EXECUTION
RECOMMENDED / NATIVE / LOCAL / CONNECTED / CUSTOM.
NATIVE ≠ LOCAL ≠ CONNECTED.
Deterministic by default; intelligence on demand.

SHARED CAPABILITY INDEPENDENCE
A capability useful to multiple Apps should, where practical, be independently
consumable through a stable contract.

APP A ─┐
APP B ─┼→ SHARED CAPABILITY → provider/platform adapters
BIFROST┘

Not by default: APP → BIFROST → SHARED CAPABILITY.

BIFROST may discover, expose, coordinate, permission, synchronize or enhance
without becoming a mandatory runtime dependency.

Reuse ladder:
REUSE → COMPOSE → EXTEND → ADAPT → EXTRACT → BUILD NEW.
Integration:
LINK → TAB / WEBAPP → EMBED → NATIVE.
